title: The Blue Loft (Upper Level)
description:
Welcome to the Blue Loft, a unique loft in the heart of Nashville designed exclusively for singer/songwriters. Nestled in a vibrant neighborhood and newly renovated, this one-of-a-kind space offers a harmonious blend of creativity and comfort, tailored to inspire and nurture your artistic journey.

This beautifully, newly renovated, clean, well stocked apartment has a 4 day minimum booking on it, removing it from being selected for bridal party tourism and partying in general.

The space
Ideal for guests working on music projects in Music City, who want a clean, safe, quiet place to wind down after working all day, to recharge their creativity. 

🛏️The apartment will comfortably hold (2) guests. There is (1) bedroom and a pull-out Queen sofa / couch. Parking is free and can hold up to (2) cars. 

🛑Unfortunately, we do not accept any 1st Bookings from new Air B&B Guests with no Prior feedback.

🔥Enjoy high speed wifi, Apple TV, Studio Apartment Size / Stocked Kitchen, Appliances, Dishes, Accessories, and Second Level Patio Deck with BBQ Grill. 

🛁 Luxury (2) Person Walk-In Granite/Stone Shower 

🚘We are conveniently located one minute away from Berry-Hill City Hall, 100 Oaks and Thompson Lane at E. Iris. We are seven minutes from Green Hills, Music Row, Airport, and Downtown Nashville (traffic permitting). PERMIT #2024099624
